items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Tricky Sam' but the interviewee does not respond or provide any information about their relationship.

ctx.x: (Humming) ... the way Vic ... boy I said I could hear him play that all night long. Every time I see him, I say, Vic play "Please Don't Talk About Me When I'm Gone." The same way we were talking today about Barry--
No about .... what's his name? Sang 'Mack the Knife.' White guy.
